<thought>To determine the number of methyl (CH₃) groups, the most direct approach is to obtain the ¹H NMR spectrum of the sample and look for signals corresponding to methyl protons (typically singlets, doublets, or triplets around 0.8–1.2 ppm with integration of 3 H each). This requires only a single inexpensive measurement.</thought>
